notablePrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Magda.
description:
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Magda, adding {U}.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Magda.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana, you may use it to activate Urza's second ability.
